Apartament 1+1 per shitje ne Paskuqan
Apartament per shitje ne nje nga zonat me te kerkuara te momentin me nje prespektive zhvillimi te shpejte.
Apartamenti eshte ne faze suvatimi dhe mbaron brenda vitit tjeter.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne rruge kryesore dhe ka mundesine e blerjes edhe te nje posti parkimi.
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in Paskuqan Apartment for sale in one of the most sought after areas at the moment with a fast development perspective. The apartment is in the plastering stage and will be finished within the next year. The apartment is located on the main road and has the possibility of purchasing a parking space.
